security.body: Owner, admin, member and viewer roles separate access. Sensitive fields are encrypted and user actions are recorded in the audit log.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Will a manager see other people's deals?
faq.a1: No. Members work with their own and unassigned tasks, the owner and admin see everything, and viewers can only read.
faq.q2: Can I move my existing database?
faq.a2: Yes. You can import contacts, find duplicates and clean up your database before launching the pipeline.
faq.a3: AI helps with next actions, statuses and short summaries based on your data. Usage is metered per tenant and visible in the log.
faq.a4: Role-based access, encryption of sensitive fields and an audit log for important actions.
